selection.ownership: Givebutter, Inc. (Wilmington, DE / Washington, DC; US nonprofit fundraising platform)

research.searchCoverage: Bounded 2026-09-13 review of official Givebutter API docs (Bearer token, https://api.givebutter.com/v1, campaigns and contacts list/get, page/per_page max 100), company about page, and dated incident search. A 2026 fee class action is not a security incident. No qualifying current unresolved Givebutter compromise was identified; this is not a breach-free claim.

Official Givebutter API uses HTTPS host https://api.givebutter.com/v1, Authorization Bearer, GET /campaigns and GET /contacts with page/per_page (max 100), and integer path IDs. Operator is Givebutter, Inc., a US fundraising platform founded in Washington, D.C. Dated incident search on 2026-09-13 found a 2026 processing-fee class action, not a qualifying unresolved data compromise.

incidents.finding: August 2026 class action alleges undisclosed processing fees. That is not a security incident. Bounded search did not identify a current unresolved Givebutter customer-data compromise.
incidents.limitation: This is not a breach-free claim; live authentication remains unverified.

research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

Returns raw Givebutter JSON under data. Optional page (1-indexed) and per_page (1–100) use official query names. Source extra query object and campaign scope filter are omitted from this bounded subset.
contact_id is a required positive integer path segment on GET /v1/contacts/{contact_id}.
Returns raw Givebutter JSON under data with the same bounded page/per_page query names. Official contact filter query names are omitted from this bounded subset.
Credential-only healthcheck probes GET /v1/campaigns?per_page=1, matching the pinned validator, and accepts empty input.
Native category is payments: Givebutter is fundraising. Source Finance is not in the Rust CATEGORIES allowlist.
